canonicalNote: This is the canonical copy. canonicalRef is null here on purpose: this file has nothing to fetch. The legacy-design-tools copy pins this file at canonicalRef=main (a BRANCH, not a commit SHA: a SHA pin would need re-pinning by hand on every canonical edit, and a squash-merge can make a branch commit unreachable, which reads as a broken gate rather than as drift) and its --check-divergence fetches and byte-compares it.
hashRule: sha256 over the file's bytes with CRLF/CR normalized to LF (Windows clones and Linux CI must agree).
